checkpoints.description: [1/4] Re-verified the benchmark report against HEAD and dropped four of its seven claims as already shipped: assistant bubbles are unboxed (theme.css 748-754), the dashed streaming border is gone, active conversation rows are already soft squircles (322-327), tabs are already capsules (1373-1403) and the statusbar already has LED dots (1503-1552). Remaining real gaps: (a) full-width bordered New conversation box in the rail, (b) streaming shows a 2px left stripe, (c) markdown h3/h4/h5 all collapse to --text-base, (d) no model chip in the composer and bare-text telemetry. Plan: ghost + trigger in the rail label, caret-based streaming with no stripe, markdown heading scale plus 1.65 prose, composer model chip that tolerates a failed config read, grouped telemetry pill. Dropping tab micro-badges: they need per-panel count plumbing for chrome that serves no task.

impact_assessment.why: The report frames five surfaces as deficits but four are already implemented, so re-implementing them would be churn on a tree that already passes its gates. Only the rail CTA, streaming indicator, type scale and composer/telemetry gaps are real.
impact_assessment.benefits: Frees 36px of rail height, replaces a dated left stripe with a calm caret, restores markdown hierarchy, and surfaces the active model in the composer without leaving the prompt.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: data-testid hooks and the statusbar cost format are test-pinned; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a new /api/config read on mount must tolerate the 404s existing UI tests return
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep every data-testid and the toFixed(6) cost string byte-identical; guard the config read so unmocked tests stay green; verify with npm test plus before/after screenshots

checkpoints.description: [milestone 1/6] Wave 0 of the engine-depth plan: the gaps are now machine-runnable rather than prose. Added tests/integration/engine-gaps.test.ts (13 tests: 6 pass, 7 it.fails pinning verified gaps), scripts/engine-gaps.ts (npm run engine:gaps) and a frozen evals/results/baselines/engine-baseline-v1.json. Re-verification corrected plan v1 twice: CRLF/BOM preservation already works end to end and is NOT a gap, and the missing tool history is deeper than a mapper bug because appendMessage only accepts user|assistant so tool results never enter the message store. 624 tests pass, typecheck and lint clean.

[1/6] Engine-depth plan: pin each verified gap, then close them wave by wave. Waves: (0) failing-fast tests + measured baseline, done in this commit; (1) derive the compaction budget from the model window, add an LLM summariser with mechanical fallback, re-inject an artifact manifest, and give the message store a tool role so a resumed run sees its tool results; (2) edit-match cascade for indentation and CRLF/LF, plus a read ledger with stale-write refusal reusing the FILE_CONFLICT pattern; (3) parallel read batches and real background shells; (4) per-step retry and a normalised doom-loop signature; (5) CLI parity (-p, --model, stdin, --no-session, -r, finer exit codes). CRLF/BOM serialisation is already correct and is excluded.

impact_assessment.why: The engine cannot hold a real repository in context (24k compaction against a 200k-1M window), cannot heal ordinary model drift in edits, can clobber a file it never read, and forgets its own tool results on resume. These are the gaps that stop real work completing; tool breadth and UI are not the constraint.
impact_assessment.benefits: A run can use the window the model actually has, a resumed run keeps its tool history, edits stop being refused over whitespace, and an unread or externally changed file cannot be silently overwritten.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: data-testid, exit codes and docs/FEATURES.md are pinned claims; dependency: none added; concurrency: parallel reads share the effect ledger and approval prompts; state: a model-backed summariser adds a provider call that costs tokens and can fail, and a message-store role change needs a schema migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: Summariser failure degrades to the mechanical path rather than blocking a run; the schema change is additive with a version bump; parallel execution is restricted to read-only batches; every wave is re-measured against engine-baseline-v1.json and a wave with no paired numbers is not counted as done

checkpoints.description: [milestone 2/6] Waves 1 and 2 landed. (1) Context: HarnessProfile.contextTokens is now optional and a live run derives its budget from the model window via budgetForModel (192000 for a 200k-window model instead of a hardcoded 24000, 0.12 -> 0.96 of the window), ChatRequest.maxTokens is populated from the catalog maxOutput (it was declared and never set), compaction prefers a model summary with the mechanical one as fallback, and the compacted head names offloaded artifact paths so they can be re-read. (2) Edit/write correctness: edits.ts matches the exact substring first then heals CRLF/LF, trailing-whitespace or indentation drift over whole-line windows and reports the strategy; server/readLedger.ts refuses a full overwrite of a file this run has not read or that changed since, and refuses a targeted edit of a file that changed since (its oldString already pins the content). Schema 10 adds the tool-turn columns. 632 tests pass, typecheck and lint clean, 11/12 gates; agent-perf and agent-bench fail only under machine load and pass at 3.49 ms and 106.8 ms on a quiet run, both at or below their recorded baselines.

[milestone 3/6] Wave 4 landed: a transient model step is now retried up to three times with jittered backoff instead of blocking the run, while a deterministic fixture or replayed step is never retried (that would shift eval responses). Each attempt is a provider.retry event. 634 tests pass.
